The real path a byte takes, in order, for the canonical task: read a file, change it, write it back. The VISIBLE column is the honest one - roughly half of these stages produce no unprivileged counter at all, which is exactly why the GPU node is drawn as a dead hole and why there is no 'task finished' event anywhere in the system.
